Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one landscape inline painting for Kanji Trail's Gulliver’s Travels, placed after paragraph 2. Input images: Images 1–3 are the approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings for style only. Image 4 is the Gulliver cover for character identity and palette only; do not copy its giant-on-beach composition, cover texture, or detail level. Primary request: show the moment Gulliver wakes on the shore in Lilliput and first notices its tiny inhabitants. Subject: Lemuel Gulliver, an adult English ship's surgeon with tousled brown curls, indigo long coat, ochre waistcoat, ivory neckcloth and brown breeches matching the cover, lies on a simple grassy shore, astonished but unharmed. A few fine threads lightly tether his sleeves and one hand to the ground. A small group of people no more than fifteen centimetres tall flee across his legs after his shout; a few carry tiny simple bows as described, with no arrows in flight. Keep the scale clear but the people gentle and nonthreatening. Scene: quiet green shore with a few broad grasses and a distant soft horizon, no clutter. Style: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, natural proportions, small expressive features, quiet simplified background with two or three depth layers; simpler than cover art. Palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, soft sage, ochre and restrained brown. Composition: full-bleed 12:7 landscape, medium-wide, Gulliver is the clear focal subject and remains readable at small size. Constraints: match this early paragraph only; no arrows, wounds, storm, shipwreck action, later events, Japanese setting, text, lettering, signs, borders, watermark, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense rigging or cover-level texture.

Primary request: show Gulliver reunited with his wife and children at their home in England after he has returned safely. Scene: Gulliver bends down carefully to embrace his wife and two children at the doorway of a modest late-seventeenth-century English home. The family is relieved and joyful. Keep the domestic setting simple, with a warm window and a few broad wooden and ivory shapes; no maps or ships. Subject: Gulliver's tousled brown curls, indigo coat, ochre waistcoat and ivory neckcloth match the cover; wife and children wear simple period-appropriate English clothes in muted teal, sage and warm ivory. Their expressions are gentle, natural and small-featured. Style: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background with two or three depth layers; simpler than cover art. Palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, sage, ochre and restrained terracotta. Composition: full-bleed 12:7 landscape, medium-wide, family clearly readable and one calm focal grouping. Constraints: depict only the written homecoming, no foreshadowing of another voyage, no tiny people, ships, text, lettering, signage, borders, watermark, photorealism, glossy 3D, elaborate interior or cover-level texture.
